editorial:
Imagine a group of total losers who have the world against them, and then imagine they decide to rob a bank. You get a wild ride with four physically disabled criminals who are just as mean and greedy as any typical movie gangster. The vibe is gritty and dark, but it is also surprisingly funny because these characters just do not care about being polite or correct. They spend most of their time arguing and insulting each other, which makes the chemistry feel real and chaotic. You will find yourself rooting for them even though they are technically bad people, simply because they are the underdogs in a world that ignores them.

What really makes this work is the acting and the way the plot keeps twisting. Just when you think you know who is in charge, someone pulls a fast one. The pacing is quick, though some of the dialogue is pretty rough, so be ready for a lot of swearing. If you like crime stories that feel raw and unpredictable, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the group realizes they cannot trust each other with the money. After the heist, the hidden agendas come out, leading to a messy showdown where their disabilities become part of the fight. In the end, the greed destroys them. Most of the crew ends up betrayed or dead, proving that their hatred for each other was stronger than their bond. It is a bleak ending that shows nobody really wins when you are a lowlife.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and heist movies with a twist.
